title: Adopt framework governance: records, backlog, release record, archives
objective: Restore machine-checked governance to this project, which declared the AI Project Framework in prose but carried no project.json. Preserve the hand-written current state and tracker intact in docs/archive/, add project.json with budgets, move every open tracker item to a task record or the budgeted backlog with its ID kept, record the live production release as a state/releases record, add the startup brief and the single documentation map, configure validation only from commands proven to run here, and record the framework dependency snapshot. Planned as ai-project-framework task T-0028 under docs/procedures/PROJECT-READOPTION.md; nothing is deleted and no application code, container, database or route changes.
acceptance: docs/archive/ holds the former CURRENT-STATE.md and TASK-TRACKER.md intact with provenance headers; a tombstone keeps the old tracker path landing.

Every open item in the tracker (WC and OC rows, the UI audit, C2 acceptance, the portability remainder, Batches E and J, CAL-P3-007, the offline idea) has one named destination and still appears in the archived tracker; the gate report in the framework's migration record shows zero loss.
state/releases/R-20260919-01.json records the production release 953e48a with its authorization, evidence, verification and rollback references; the generated CURRENT-STATE.md shows it.
project.json validation lists only commands run here first; check and render are clean; bootstrap --strict passes; the framework_dependency snapshot is recorded.
non_goals: No application code, schema, container, database or Cloudflare route change.
No deletion of history; archive whole documents.
No merge, deployment, live-data mutation, or account change unless separately authorized.
